methods.label: Group consecutive terms
methods.explanation:
The numerators repeat every two terms, so group consecutive pairs. The first pair is
\[
\frac17+\frac2{7^2}=\frac9{49}.
\]
Each later pair is \(\frac1{49}\) times the preceding pair. Since \(\left|\frac1{49}\right|<1\), the resulting geometric series converges, with sum
\[
\frac{9/49}{1-1/49}
=\frac9{48}
=\frac3{16}.
\]
This also gives the limit of the original partial sums: those ending after a pair approach \(\frac3{16}\), and an odd partial sum differs from the preceding even one by \(\frac1{7^{2n+1}}\), which tends to zero. Thus the sum is \(\boxed{\frac3{16}}\). It is absent from choices A through D, so the answer is E.
